title: Which Verity Character Are You?
summary: Which Verity character are you? Discover whether you’re more Verity or Lowen and find the Scentbird fragrance collection that matches your side.
body_markdown:
Two characters. Two perspectives. Two very different ways to wear the story.


*Verity* is coming to the big screen, and we’re bringing its world somewhere unexpected: your fragrance collection.


You know the feeling: the questions, the second-guessing, the moment you think you’ve figured everything out—only to wonder if you’ve had it wrong all along.


For a limited time,[Scentbird](https://www.scentbird.com/) is bringing Verity and Lowen to life through scent, with two exclusive fragrance collections inspired by the characters at the center of the story.


One polished and magnetic. The other fresh and instinctive. The question is: which one pulls you in?


## Are You More Verity or Lowen?


### If You’re a Verity: Polished, Mysterious, Magnetic


There’s a polish to Verity. A presence. Something magnetic that makes you want to get closer—even when your instincts are telling you otherwise.


Her fragrance collection lives in that tension. Decadent accords meet darker notes and intoxicating blends that reveal themselves slowly. These are scents that make an entrance, leave an impression, and keep a little something to themselves.


Wear one out after dark. Wear one when you want to feel impossible to read. Wear one when you don’t mind leaving a few questions behind.


Feeling magnetic?[Explore Verity’s Collection](https://www.scentbird.com/pr/verity)


### If You’re a Lowen: Instinctive, Grounded, Complex


You trust the feeling you can’t quite explain.


Lowen’s world is fresher, airier, more grounded, but don’t mistake it for simple. There’s complexity underneath it all, waiting to be uncovered.


Her collection follows that instinct with fresh, effortless accords and fragrances that feel natural from the first spray. Easy to step into. Harder to forget.


These are the scents for following a hunch, taking the long way home, or saying yes before you’ve completely talked yourself into it. Sometimes your instincts know first.


Trust your instincts? **[Explore Lowen’s Collection](https://www.scentbird.com/pr/verity)**


## Verity vs. Lowen: Which Character Matches You?


Maybe you already know: Verity’s mystery or Lowen’s intuition. Dark and magnetic or fresh and instinctive.


Try the scent that feels most like you, or cross over and discover the side you didn’t expect to choose. Because every story changes depending on who’s telling it. And sometimes, getting closer only leaves you with more questions.


The[Verity: The Scent of Truth Collection](https://www.scentbird.com/pr/verity) is available exclusively at Scentbird for a limited time.


So, are you a Verity or a Lowen?[Choose Your Side](https://www.scentbird.com/pr/verity) .
